gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-paquito: Expressive and a bit showy, Baloo Thambi 2 packs a deep midsection into its lowercase. Paquito keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, confident and approachable, and made for brief visits rather than marathons.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-glegoo: Balsamiq Sans draws its letters like bent steel rod, one constant weight with no pinched curves. But Glegoo's serif lowercase is tall, with big counters and wide, unclosed curves, refined and editorial.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-kadwa: Round and punchy, Balsamiq Sans holds a constant weight through bowls that never pinch. Kadwa, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, lends the pair a classic editorial backbone.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, with generous entrances into every curve. Balsamiq Sans leads with strokes that never thin to a hairline, so page after page of the serif below feels steady and unhurried.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is a refined, authoritative serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Balsamiq Sans is built for blunt, steel-rod emphasis, while Piazzolla is built for sustained, authoritative text with its pried-open e.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-scope-one: Balsamiq Sans keeps one constant weight, like a stencil-cut channel. Scope One sets spilling counters and stubby ascenders against a big x-height, so the rod-like heading gets a traditional, refined foil.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-karma: Distinctive and expressive, Battambang compresses its ascenders and opens every curve. Karma's serif letters, with gentle modulation that never snags the eye, lend the pair a trustworthy, classic footing.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional, refined serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. And with Baumans up top, whose lines look like bent tubing, Hanuman text would read smoothly all the way down.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-slabo-13px: Baumans' c gapes like a crescent wrench, every stroke one thickness. Slabo 13px, a bookish, dignified serif, has large open counters in its tall lowercase, plus clear openings in rounded letters.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-hanuman: Commanding and distinctive, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, every stroke traced at one stylus width. Hanuman's high-waisted serif lowercase is the refined, traditional counterweight here.
